content.text: Tainted header value is URL-decoded (not sanitized) and placed directly into a shell command executed via `sh -c "echo <param>"`. No validation/escaping occurs, so this is a genuine command injection.

input.justification: The HTTP header "BenchmarkTest00006" is read directly from the request, URL-decoded (which does not sanitize shell metacharacters), and concatenated into a string passed as an argument to `sh -c` / `cmd.exe /c` via ProcessBuilder. There is no validation, allow-listing, or escaping of the value before it reaches the command execution sink, so an attacker-controlled header can inject arbitrary shell commands (e.g., via `;`, `|`, backticks, etc.).
